sections.heading: About these concepts and plans
sections.text: The four theme pictures on this page are AI-generated style concepts by Maison. They are not photos of an actual unit, not completed Maison projects and not surveyed layouts; layouts, fittings and views are illustrative. The floor plans are reproduced from the HDB-authored Towner Residences sales brochure ([archive copy](https://btohq.sgp1.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/bto/aug-2021-bto/towner-residences.pdf), printed p.10 and p.12). They are not construction drawings; confirm your own approved plan, stack and any mirroring before adapting an idea.

faq.a: HDB’s brochure states 3-room: approx. 68 sqm including the air-con ledge (65 sqm internal), and 4-room: approx. 93 sqm including the air-con ledge (90 sqm internal). The ledge is not usable living space. Printed p.12 shows two 4-room arrangements; confirm your own stack and any mirroring.

faq.q: How does the first 4-room arrangement work?
faq.a: In the first arrangement on p.12, three bedrooms line the plan-top edge. Living/dining sits plan-left, the shelter beside the lower-left entrance, kitchen at the bottom and service yard to its right; bathrooms are beside this service zone. These are diagram-relative directions, not compass facings.

The specifications name aluminium-framed tinted windows, glazed porcelain kitchen floor/wall tiles and an aluminium-framed glazed service-yard door. Polished porcelain living floors and vinyl bedroom floors are optional OCS items, not universal supply. Render colours, cabinetry, counters, furniture and light fittings are design proposals.

No. They are AI-generated style concepts, not photos of a Towner Residences unit and not completed Maison projects. Room shapes, fittings, furniture and window views are illustrative. Individual room dimensions were not published, so check your approved owner plan and a measured survey before construction.

faq.q: Are keys officially confirmed for a particular month?
faq.a: No project-wide current key date was confirmed. Historical third-party estimates are not an appointment. Confirm your own HDB handover and defects process.

Inspect and report defects, coordinate rectification, survey the home, confirm the HDB renovation and permitted-work requirements, then procure and build. Any 8–12-week example is a conditional planning allowance, not a Maison guarantee. Never alter the household shelter or structural elements based on a concept image.
